jobs.description:
Title:
Senior Actuarial Analyst
Company:
Everest Global Services, Inc.
Job Category:
Analytics
Job Description:
About Everest:
Everest is a global leader in risk management, rooted in a rich, 50+ year heritage of enabling businesses to survive and thrive, and economies to function and flourish. We are underwriters of risk, growth, progress and opportunity. We are a global team focused on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for all stakeholders, who care deeply about our impact on communities and the wider world.
Background
The Actuarial Solutions team is part of Group Actuarial and is responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting Everest’s global pricing tools, which are key to the success of Everest’s reinsurance business.
This is an opportunity for an actuary with experience in developing reinsurance pricing tools, or a reinsurance pricing actuary with an interest in developing pricing tools, to play an active roll in a worldwide project upgrading Everest’s global reinsurance pricing tool.
The Actuarial Solutions team is also responsible for other technology-related applications, such as reporting, process automation, etc. across pricing, reserving, and other actuarial work, group-wide.
Preferred location : Zurich, London, possibly New York or Warren, NJ.
Key Responsibilities

• Working as part of the Actuarial Solutions team contribute to the development of the new Everest’s Reinsurance pricing tool

• Propose UI designs, actuarial methodologies, platform architecture, etc., consistent with Everest’s reinsurance pricing approaches

• Gather and respond to user feedback from pricing tool users, actuaries and underwriters, on reinsurance pricing.

• Program pricing tool features

• Help ensure the quality and reliability of the new platform through involvement in testing and quality control

• Collaborate with IT and other internal teams on the pricing tool build
In addition, as part of the Solutions team support business-as-usual pricing tool operation

• Support users through troubleshooting, debugging, and issue-resolution for Solutions applications

• Help represent the wishes of international (worldwide excluding US) users in wider discussions

• Help prepare user documentation, guidance materials, and training content.

• Support reinsurance pricing during renewal periods using Everest’s pricing tools.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Experience in developing reinsurance pricing tools, for example being involved in programming, architecture or UI design etc.

• Strong interest in software development, with experience in at least some of the following: Python, VBA/Excel, SQL, web application development.

• 5 years relevant experience

• Experience working with commercially available platforms for (re)insurance pricing tools an advantage

• Experience and interest in leveraging AI for the efficient development of high-quality applications

• Strong data manipulation skills, ideally using SQL, Python (Pandas/Polars), or R (dplyr).

• Experience in reinsurance pricing.

• Familiarity with modern software development practices (e.g., Git, unit testing, AI).

Qualifications / Experience / Aptitudes

• University degree in science, actuarial science, IT / data-science, mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Qualified actuary or actuarial experience, or actively working toward actuarial qualifications

• Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Team player with experience working on large or complex software projects.

What if I don’t meet every requirement? At Everest we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. So, if you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every element in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Please let us know if you need any accommodations throughout the applic

• Forte interesse per lo sviluppo del software, con esperienza in almeno alcuni dei seguenti: Python, VBA/Excel, SQL, sviluppo di applicazioni web.
• 5 anni di esperienza rilevante
• Esperienza di lavoro con piattaforme commercialmente disponibili per (re)insurance pricing tools un vantaggio
• Esperienza e interesse a sfruttare AI per lo sviluppo efficiente di applicazioni di alta qualità
• Forte capacità di manipolazione dei dati, idealmente utilizzando SQL, Python (Pandas/Polars), o R (dplyr).
• Esperienza nei prezzi di riassicurazione.
• Familiarità con le moderne pratiche di sviluppo software (ad esempio, Git, test unità, AI). Qualificazioni / Esperienza / Aptitudes
• Laurea in scienze, scienze attuariali, IT / data-scienza, matematica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Esperienza attuariale o attuariale qualificata, o attivazione verso qualifiche attuariali
• Forte capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con diversi stakeholder.
• Giocatore di squadra con esperienza lavorando su progetti software di grandi o complessi. E se non soddisfassi ogni esigenza? A Everest siamo dedicati alla costruzione di un posto di lavoro inclusivo e autentico. Quindi, se siete entusiasti di questo ruolo, ma la vostra esperienza passata non si allinea perfettamente con ogni elemento nella descrizione del lavoro, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare. Si può essere solo il candidato giusto per questo o altri ruoli. Vi preghiamo di farci sapere se avete bisogno di alloggi in tutta l'applic

jobs.description:
Title:
Senior Underwriting Assistant
Company:
Everest Reinsurance Company (Ireland), Dac
Job Category:
Underwriting Operations
Job Description:
Reinsurance Underwriting Assistant I
Are you interested in a career in underwriting? This is a fantastic opportunity for smart, intuitive, inquisitive minds to join a leading global financial organization that is genuinely passionate about the development of our entry level employees and future leaders. We pride ourselves on nurturing talent and kick-starting lifelong careers in a professional, exciting, and long-standing industry.
For 50 years, Everest has been a global leader in reinsurance with a broad, international footprint and deep, long-term, profitable client relationships. We have a reputation for underwriting excellence, and we focus on delivering responsive client service and customized solutions. We are ranked in the Top Ten Reinsurers worldwide. This is a huge financial services and risk management industry and Everest Re is a key player.
This open position provides hands-on learning with an opportunity to work alongside some of the best reinsurance professionals in the market within underwriting, actuarial, data analysis and claims.

So, what is reinsurance?
Essentially, it’s the insurance of insurance. Our clients are insurance companies who need additional protection for the risks they assume. But this additional protection is not for the standard car, home, and pet coverage you might think of when you hear the word ‘insurance’. Here at Everest, we reinsure special, high- value or high-risk businesses and industries across different classes of insurance such as Aviation, Property, Engineering, Public and Employers’ Liability, Professional Indemnity, Medical Malpractice, Accident & Health, Contingency and Cyber…….
When the worst happens, a policyholder is reliant on their Insurer to help them recover and move forward. But what happens when a hurricane hits the USA, a major music festival is cancelled or a CEO’s ill-timed tweet plunges a company’s share price? Thematic events like this can result in huge losses for Insurers and that is where reinsurance comes in. Reinsurers like Everest Re not only pay claims at the time of loss; more importantly, we provide business continuity.

What is the role of a Reinsurance Underwriter?
The job of the reinsurance underwriter is to assess and select risks. The underwriter’s role is both technical and commercial as the underwriter must determine how much risk to assume and at what cost, what are best terms and conditions of coverage, as well as negotiate and sell the deal to our broker clients.
The actuaries are crucial in helping us achieve a profitable portfolio through analysis of numerical data and trends and determining appropriate risk-adjusted prices. Actuaries also work to determine how much we should “reserve” for current and future losses.
Our claims executives evaluate claims to determine if coverage applies and what the final indemnity should be to adequately compensate for the loss, which is the ultimate purpose of insurance and reinsurance.

The successful candidate will report to the head of western Europe and assist the Underwriting team with the following.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

• Underwriting support and analysis work for the underwriting teams:
• Trip preparation and trip follow up

• Client management and market reviews

• Reporting tasks

• Internal communication with other departments (Accounting, Claims, IT, etc).

• Desk research on specific topics

• Prepare and assist the underwriter on account renewals
• Data preparation

• Check of contractual documents

• Analysis of treaties and portfolios

• Administration and compliance
• Data entry and maintenance in the data and accounting systems.

• Assistance on specific projects management tasks.

• Assisting underwriters during the underwriting process, with also a chance to get a handle on the technical tools used to evaluate risk.

Titolo: Senior Underwriting Assistant Azienda: Everest Reinsurance Company (Irlanda), Dac Categoria di lavoro: Operazioni di sottoscrizione Descrizione del lavoro: Assistente di sottoscrizione di assicurazione I Sei interessato a una carriera di sottoscrizione? Questa è una fantastica opportunità per menti intelligenti, intuitive e intuitive per unire un'organizzazione finanziaria globale leader che è sinceramente appassionato per lo sviluppo dei nostri dipendenti di livello di ingresso e leader futuri. Siamo orgogliosi di nutrire talento e kick-starting carriera per tutta la vita in un settore professionale, emozionante e di lunga data. Per 50 anni, Everest è stato un leader globale nella riassicurazione con un'impronta internazionale ampia e relazioni clienti profonde, a lungo termine e redditizie. Abbiamo la reputazione di sottoscrivere l'eccellenza, e ci concentriamo sulla fornitura di servizi client reattivi e soluzioni personalizzate. Siamo classificati nella Top Ten Reinsurers in tutto il mondo. Si tratta di un enorme settore finanziario e gestione del rischio e Everest Re è un giocatore chiave. Questa posizione aperta offre l'apprendimento pratico con l'opportunità di lavorare insieme ad alcuni dei migliori professionisti della riassicurazione sul mercato all'interno di sottoscrizione, attuariale, analisi dei dati e reclami. Allora, cos'è la riassicurazione? Essenzialmente, è l'assicurazione dell'assicurazione. I nostri clienti sono compagnie di assicurazione che hanno bisogno di protezione aggiuntiva per i rischi che assumono. Ma questa protezione aggiuntiva non è per la copertura standard di auto, casa e animale domestico che si potrebbe pensare quando si sente la parola 'assicurazione'. Qui a Everest, riassicurare le imprese e le industrie speciali, ad alto valore o ad alto rischio in diverse classi di assicurazione come Aviazione, Proprietà, Ingegneria, Pubblica e Datori di lavoro di responsabilità, Indennità professionale, Malpratica medica, Accident & Salute, Contingency e Cyber.... Quando il peggio accade, un assicuratore si affida al loro assicuratore per aiutarli a recuperare e andare avanti. Ma cosa succede quando un uragano colpisce gli Stati Uniti, un grande festival di musica viene annullato o un tweet del CEO si immerge il prezzo di condivisione di una società? Gli eventi tematici come questo possono portare a enormi perdite per gli assicuratori ed è lì che arriva la riassicurazione. Reinsurers come Everest Re non solo pagare reclami al momento della perdita; più importante, forniamo continuità aziendale. Qual è il ruolo di un Sottoscrittore di Riassicurazione? Il lavoro del sottoscrittore di riassicurazione è quello di valutare e selezionare i rischi. Il ruolo del sottoscrittore è sia tecnico che commerciale in quanto il sottoscrittore deve determinare quanto rischio di assumere e a quale costo, quali sono i migliori termini e condizioni di copertura, nonché negoziare e vendere l'affare ai nostri clienti broker. Gli attuari sono fondamentali per aiutarci a raggiungere un portafoglio redditizio attraverso l'analisi dei dati numerici e delle tendenze e la determinazione dei prezzi adeguati al rischio. Title:

Job Description:
Reinsurance Underwriting Assistant I
Are you interested in a career in underwriting? This is a fantastic opportunity for smart, intuitive, inquisitive minds to join a leading global financial organization that is genuinely passionate about the development of our entry level employees and future leaders. We pride ourselves on nurturing talent and kick-starting lifelong careers in a professional, exciting, and long-standing industry.
For 50 years, Everest has been a global leader in reinsurance with a broad, international footprint and deep, long-term, profitable client relationships. We have a reputation for underwriting excellence, and we focus on delivering responsive client service and customized solutions. We are ranked in the Top Ten Reinsurers worldwide. This is a huge financial services and risk management industry and Everest Re is a key player.
This open position provides hands-on learning with an opportunity to work alongside some of the best reinsurance professionals in the market within underwriting, actuarial, data analysis and claims.

So, what is reinsurance?
Essentially, it’s the insurance of insurance. Our clients are insurance companies who need additional protection for the risks they assume. But this additional protection is not for the standard car, home, and pet coverage you might think of when you hear the word ‘insurance’. Here at Everest, we reinsure special, high- value or high-risk businesses and industries across different classes of insurance such as Aviation, Property, Engineering, Public and Employers’ Liability, Professional Indemnity, Medical Malpractice, Accident & Health, Contingency and Cyber…….
When the worst happens, a policyholder is reliant on their Insurer to help them recover and move forward. But what happens when a hurricane hits the USA, a major music festival is cancelled or a CEO’s ill-timed tweet plunges a company’s share price? Thematic events like this can result in huge losses for Insurers and that is where reinsurance comes in. Reinsurers like Everest Re not only pay claims at the time of loss; more importantly, we provide business continuity.

What is the role of a Reinsurance Underwriter?
The job of the reinsurance underwriter is to assess and select risks. The underwriter’s role is both technical and commercial as the underwriter must determine how much risk to assume and at what cost, what are best terms and conditions of coverage, as well as negotiate and sell the deal to our broker clients.
The actuaries are crucial in helping us achieve a profitable portfolio through analysis of numerical data and trends and determining appropriate risk-adjusted prices. Actuaries also work to determine how much we should “reserve” for current and future losses.
Our claims executives evaluate claims to determine if coverage applies and what the final indemnity should be to adequately compensate for the loss, which is the ultimate purpose of insurance and reinsurance.

The successful candidate will report to the head of western Europe and assist the Underwriting team with the following.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

• Underwriting support and analysis work for the underwriting teams:
• Trip preparation and trip follow up

• Client management and market reviews

• Reporting tasks

• Internal communication with other departments (Accounting, Claims, IT, etc).

• Desk research on specific topics

• Prepare and assist the underwriter on account renewals
• Data preparation

• Check of contractual documents

• Analysis of treaties and portfolios

• Administration and compliance
• Data entry and maintenance in the data and accounting systems.

• Assistance on specific projects management tasks.

• Assisting underwriters during the underwriting process, with also a chance to get a handle on the technical tools used to evaluate risk.

Dies ist eine fantastische Gelegenheit für intelligente, intuitive und neugierige Köpfe, sich einer führenden globalen Finanzorganisation anzuschließen, die sich wirklich für die Entwicklung unserer Einstiegsmitarbeiter und zukünftigen Führungskräfte begeistert. Wir sind stolz darauf, Talente zu fördern und lebenslange Karrieren in einer professionellen, aufregenden und langjährigen Branche anzustoßen. Seit 50 Jahren ist Everest weltweit führend in der Rückversicherung mit einer breiten, internationalen Präsenz und tiefen, langfristigen, profitablen Kundenbeziehungen. Wir haben den Ruf, Exzellenz zu zeichnen, und wir konzentrieren uns auf die Bereitstellung von reaktionsschnellem Kundenservice und maßgeschneiderten Lösungen. Wir gehören zu den Top Ten Rückversicherern weltweit. Dies ist eine riesige Finanzdienstleistungs- und Risikomanagementbranche und Everest Re ist ein wichtiger Akteur. Diese offene Position bietet praktisches Lernen mit der Möglichkeit, neben einigen der besten Rückversicherungsexperten auf dem Markt in den Bereichen Underwriting, Versicherungsmathematik, Datenanalyse und Schadensfälle zu arbeiten. Was ist also Rückversicherung? Im Wesentlichen ist es die Versicherung der Versicherung. Unsere Kunden sind Versicherungsgesellschaften, die zusätzlichen Schutz für die Risiken benötigen, die sie übernehmen. Aber dieser zusätzliche Schutz ist nicht für die Standard-Auto-, Haus- und Haustierabdeckung, an die Sie denken könnten, wenn Sie das Wort "Versicherung" hören. Hier am Everest versichern wir spezielle, hochwertige oder risikoreiche Unternehmen und Branchen in verschiedenen Versicherungsklassen wie Luftfahrt, Eigentum, Ingenieurwesen, öffentliche und Arbeitgeberhaftung, Berufshaftpflicht, medizinisches Fehlverhalten, Unfall & Gesundheit, Notfall und Cyber. Wenn das Schlimmste passiert, ist ein Versicherungsnehmer auf seinen Versicherer angewiesen, um ihm zu helfen, sich zu erholen und voranzukommen. Aber was passiert, wenn ein Hurrikan die USA trifft, ein großes Musikfestival abgesagt wird oder der unzeitgemäße Tweet eines CEO den Aktienkurs eines Unternehmens senkt? Thematische Ereignisse wie diese können zu enormen Verlusten für Versicherer führen, und hier kommt die Rückversicherung ins Spiel. Rückversicherer wie Everest Re zahlen nicht nur Forderungen zum Zeitpunkt des Verlustes; was noch wichtiger ist, wir bieten Geschäftskontinuität. Welche Rolle spielt ein Rückversicherer? Die Aufgabe des Rückversicherungsversicherers besteht darin, Risiken zu bewerten und auszuwählen. Die Rolle des Underwriters ist sowohl technisch als auch kaufmännisch, da der Underwriter bestimmen muss, wie viel Risiko er übernehmen soll und zu welchen Kosten, was die besten Deckungsbedingungen sind, sowie den Deal an unsere Broker-Kunden zu verhandeln und zu verkaufen. Die Versicherungsmathematiker sind entscheidend, um uns zu helfen, ein profitables Portfolio durch die Analyse numerischer Daten und Trends und die Bestimmung angemessener risikoadjustierter Preise zu erreichen. Versicherungsmathematiker arbeiten auch daran, zu bestimmen, wie viel wir für aktuelle und zukünftige Verluste „reservieren sollten. Unsere Schadenverursacher bewerten die Schadensfälle, um festzustellen, ob eine Deckung besteht und wie die endgültige Entschädigung aussehen sollte, um den Verlust angemessen zu kompensieren, was der letztendliche Zweck von Versicherungen und Rückversicherungen ist.
